note: BH-6838: 1 turns on `dispatch`, the daily full harness-ci run on main. Default 0 (off): the nightly workflow (harness-nightly.yml) runs the whole corpus on main each day and files one issue per red suite, and a red dispatch run of harness-ci.yml can freeze merges. Off logs `dispatch: skip dispatch-off` and makes no gh call. `collect` runs either way.
